dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Hazel Blue is on the at-risk list due to medical concerns. Hazel Blue is a friendly, sweet geriatric dog who was surrendered due to her owner moving. We have assessed that Hazel Blue has multiple medical comorbidities including a large mammary gland tumor, severe dental disease and possible osteoarthritis. Further follow up with outside vet care may be considered, or palliative care may be appropriate so long as Hazel Blue has a good quality of life and is comfortable. Hazel Blue has allowed all handling and seeks attention during their exams.
dog.name: Hazel Blue
